rules.sentence: Sezary syndrome should be differentiated from mycosis fungoides, psoriasis, pityriasis rubra pilaris, dermatitis, hypereosinophilic syndrome, and adult T-cell leukemia.

Skin classification, disease stage, elevated lactate dehydrogenase levels, advanced age, comorbidities, race, male sex, peripheral eosinophilia, large cell transformation, and folliculotropic mycosis fungoides are all factors associated with poor prognosis.
